summary: The PR addresses the issue of precomputing the CDF for several distributions, improving performance and correctness. The changes are well-structured and consistent with the existing codebase.

issues.description: While the PR provides precomputed CDFs for several distributions, it does not address all distributions mentioned in the issue description. However, this is not a blocking issue as the PR makes significant progress.
There are minor style inconsistencies, such as unnecessary blank lines and inconsistent spacing around operators. These are minor and do not affect functionality.
